summary: Iteration 11: Quiz flow testing in ChatPage. The 'Give me a quick quiz' feature was tested end-to-end. Quiz modal opens correctly after ~8-10 seconds (AI generation), MCQ options render, Multiple Choice badge shown, and quiz-modal is visible with correct z-index. Key confirmation: quiz API returns type='mcq' for all questions (backend fix working). Full submit-to-results flow was partially blocked by rate limiting on logins after multiple test runs.
critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiting on login ('Too many login attempts') blocked completing the full submit-to-results test flow in Playwright automation. This is expected behavior, not a bug.
Quiz generation takes ~8-10 seconds due to AI call. Playwright tests must wait this long before checking for quiz-modal selector.
The quiz modal correctly renders with display:flex, visibility:visible, opacity:1, z-index:50 when setQuizModal is called.

success_rate.frontend: 75% - Quiz modal opens correctly, MCQ options shown, type badge correct, next/submit button behavior confirmed via code review. Submit-to-results-to-chat flow not tested due to login rate limiting.

seed_data_creation: Multiple chat sessions created during testing (14 AI Sessions shown in dashboard)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quiz modal IS working. Key finding: it takes ~8-10 seconds (AI call) before quiz-modal appears in DOM. Use response interceptor or poll with 500ms intervals up to 30s. Login rate limiting hits after ~5-6 test runs - space out test runs. Confirmed working: quiz API returns type=mcq, modal renders with correct display/visibility/z-index. Screenshot saved at .screenshots/quiz_modal_ok.jpg (from test 4). The next agent should verify: submit quiz -> results phase (score%) -> close modal -> quiz results appear in chat -> AI responds.
rca_of_issues: Previously reported bugs (no options, disabled next button, results in modal instead of chat) were all fixed: (1) Backend normalizes type='mcq' for all questions with options - VERIFIED working. (2) Frontend infers qType = question?.type || (question?.options?.length ? 'mcq' : 'short_answer') - VERIFIED correct. (3) onComplete sends quiz results as chat message via sendMessage(msg) - code confirmed correct.
